assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production background plate for a 1990s hand-painted cel anime, Heralds of the Cemi, shot S01-01. Reference image establishes mangrove shapes, ink-navy and green-black palette and painted style only. New composition: 4:3 extreme close-up low above moonless black river water, water fills entire frame, distant mangrove reflections near upper edge, quiet irregular horizontal blue-gray reflection strokes and soft dark jade reflections. Restrained gouache background painting, analog late-1990s anime atmosphere, simple readable shapes. No moon, no visible sky, no bright moonbeam reflection, no paddle, no canoe, no people, no text, no borders. Full bleed, flat water surface perspective, subdued detail so a paddle animation can be composited in foreground. Deliver one clean painted background, 1536x1152 if possible.

Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target reference image of the empty mangrove river. Preserve this exact background's river perspective, tree shapes, detailed painted root banks and water horizon. Remove the moon completely and replace bright sky with a dark overcast moonless ink-navy night sky. Remove the bright reflected moon streak from water; use restrained diffuse desaturated blue-gray reflections only. Make the entire palette green-black and ink-navy, painted 1990s cel anime gouache, readable dark silhouettes with muted edge colors. No people, boats, new objects, lettering, glow, or magical effects. Full bleed wide production background, existing geometry stays fixed; deliberately subdued moonless exposure.

Use case: illustration-story. Production ANIMATION CEL SHEET on genuinely transparent alpha, 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equal square cells, 2048x1024 requested. Each cell is one successive drawing of THE SAME long simple dark brown carved wooden canoe paddle in a restrained 1990s cel anime. Camera at waterline close-up: diagonal shaft upper right to broad blade lower left, small cool gray-blue water splash/ripple at blade tip. Flat two-tone paint, strong thin navy outlines, muted night values. NO people/hands/boats/backgrounds/text/grid lines. Keep the entire paddle inside each cell with generous transparent margins, consistent paddle proportions and center registration. Reading order eight consecutive poses of ONE slow paddling stroke: 1 blade above water at right; 2 tip touching surface; 3 blade entering narrow splash; 4 submerged lower blade obscured by stylized small blue-gray waterline, shaft tilted; 5 pull stroke left, curved ripple; 6 end of pull, blade rotated edge-on; 7 blade rising left with three falling droplets; 8 recovery blade lifted back toward right, dripping. Pose changes subtle, natural physically consistent pivot, no rubber deformation. Water effects sparse isolated linework on transparent alpha, never a rectangle of painted water. Each of eight cels separately usable with no overlapping cell boundaries. This is an internal exposure sheet that will be cropped and composited as full-frame moving animation, not displayed as a grid.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production cel animation sheet for Heralds of the Cemi shot S01-03. Input1 Amaia identity/model reference, input2 her toddler son identity reference. Draw 6 successive cels of the SAME fixed medium close-up composition, 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, transparent background, no labels/grid/borders. Amaia in white one-shoulder wrap, brown skin, long black wavy ponytail with white tie, exhausted guarded face, holding her sleeping black-haired toddler in white securely against her ribs. She looks toward screen right counting people ahead. Match the references' face, nose, eyebrows, proportions and costume exactly; simplify to restrained 1990s flat two-tone cel anime with thin navy outlines and subdued cool night shading, NO orange rim light. Composition within every cell identical, Amaia's head at same location/size, toddler asleep lower right, waist-up figure, transparent margins. ONLY lips/eyes and one tiny hair tuft change: cel1 lips closed eyes right; cel2 tiny parted counting mouth eyes right; cel3 narrow counting mouth; cel4 eyelids halfway closing, closed mouth; cel5 eyes fully closed blink, closed mouth; cel6 eyes open slightly down toward child, closed mouth. No body pose shifts, no extra hands, no duplicates within a cell, no background/water/canoe, no face warping or painterly realistic rendering. Preserve the toddler's sleeping pose unchanged in all six cels. True RGBA transparency.
assets.cleanup: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact six-cel sheet, preserve every character pixel, identity, line, color, pose, composition and 3-column 2-row alignment. Remove ALL dark gradient background, brown haze, drop shadows, halos and horizontal haze bands between rows. Every pixel outside the silhouettes of Amaia and her sleeping son must be fully transparent alpha=0. All character interior pixels fully opaque. Clean hard cel edges with only 1px antialiasing. No drawn checkerboard, no replacement background, no glow, no artistic changes. Preserve exact canvas dimensions1536x1024.
